description: This file contains utility functions and data structures related to JSON parsing, color handling, error processing, and session key normalization within the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It provides helper functions for serializing/deserializing JSON, color conversion, and error message extraction, aiding the main application logic.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a 4-tuple of any types A, B, C, D.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a String into a JSON-escaped string, handling special characters.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to JsonObject if possible, or returns null.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, or returns null if invalid or blank.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value associated with a key from a JsonObject.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a String value from a JsonObject by key.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Extracts a Boolean value from a JsonObject key, interpreting 'true'/'false'.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the String content of a JsonElement if possible, otherwise null.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Long with ARGB format, or null if invalid.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts error code and message from a Throwable using a custom parser.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims a given string and returns null if empty, for session key normalization.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key is equal to 'main', indicating a canonical session key.
